definition.value: This extension indicates whether or not the patient's/person's identity is known.

comment.value: This extension may be used to indicate that the patient has not had their identity fully verified using methods such as reviewing identity documents (passport, driver's license) or passing knowledge-based identification checks. Some reasons a patient may not have a known identity include being unconscious when presenting (for example, in the emergency department) or signing up in a patient portal online, providing only self-attested demographics. Some implementations may leverage this extension with additional code values for other purposes such as verification level, so the presence of this extension alone should not be used to determine that the identity is unknown.

requirements.value: Supports exchange of the HL7 v2 PID-31 Identity Unknown Indicator concept when mapping v2 messages to FHIR Patient resources.
